text:
anya: Heads up  planning to be in Bangkok from 2026-05-10 to 2026-07-05 (~57 days). Want to confirm: 1) do I need a visa for this length, 2) will WFH stipend continue, 3) does this trigger any tax or payroll changes, and 4) can we ship a second monitor there?
people-ops: Hi @anya  thanks for the notice. Short answers: 1) visa depends on nationality; please attach passport + intended entry info in the Homebase Change form, 2) stipend typically continues and is prorated for partial months, 3) tax nexus risk is low for <90 days in many APAC countries but depends on activities; we'll queue a nexus check, 4) monitor shipping possible under temporary shipping cap (different from relocation).
hr-benefits: FYI on health: US group medical generally does not provide full international coverage except emergency care. Recommend short-term travel medical if you'll be outside the US for multiple weeks. If you want, we can check eligibility for the global medical rider. Also note telehealth options may vary by country.
tax-eng: @anya please confirm whether you'll meet local customers, participate in hiring interviews locally, or sign contracts while there. Those activities increase nexus risk. Purely heads-down dev + async collaboration usually keeps risk lower but we'll run our external tax partner check. Also note Thailand has social security rules for work performed in-country by employees; <183 days is relevant but not determinative.
payroll-ops: If tax partner flags a need to route via our EOR for Thailand we may temporarily change payroll routing which can affect tax withholding and benefits. For short trips we try to keep staff on USD payroll; we'll confirm before the trip starts. Please confirm whether you'd accept USD payroll for the trip.
it-ship: We can ship a second monitor under temporary shipping cap of $1,500. Open a ticket in `#it-ship` with asset request and delivery address in Bangkok. We'll need local customs paperwork and receipts to clear.
anya: No customer meetings, purely dev & async. I'll stay at my current US address for benefits. Happy to stay on USD payroll. Will open `#it-ship` ticket for monitor (asset-778).
people-ops-bot: Policy note: "Short-term APAC Remote (<=90 days)" guidance added to policy hub: https://redwood.company/policies/short-term-remote-apac. Checklist: Homebase Change form, passport copy, flight itinerary, local contact, receipts upload.
people-ops: Action items for @anya: 1) submit Homebase Change form and attach passport + flight, 2) open `#it-ship` ticket for monitor with asset tag + Bangkok address, 3) confirm USD payroll ok (done), 4) we'll queue tax nexus review and update in 48 business hours.
hr-benefits: Once form is in we'll message options for short-term travel medical and confirm any 401(k/benefits implications if payroll routing changes.
payroll-ops: Noted @anya remains on USD payroll unless tax partner recommends routing. If routing change is recommended we'll coordinate opt-in and explain withholding differences.
anya: Form submitted and passport uploaded. `#it-ship` ticket opened (ticket-512). Thanks all! :tada:
